changes.title: Circle reveal
items: Standing in a legend's circle, the trees and stones in front of it fade away, so you can see the whole circle and its sleeping legend
The same near a runestone (within 30 m), tonight's find and a relic flask: the woods in front of them fade while you're there

changes.title: House colour
items: In the treehouse the world keeps its true colours, no longer greyed by its slowed time: from the rooms, the Terrace and through the telescope

changes.title: Fold pause sliders
items: The pause page's test sliders are grouped under folding headers, all folded to start; a header shows how many of its sliders you've changed, and the groups you open stay open next time
